basic_info.description: Step into a significant and storied Victorian, beautifully reimagined on the best block of Liberty Street at the intersection of Eureka Valley and Noe Valley. Nestled among a row of postcard-perfect historic homes, this is quintessential San Francisco. The grand facade is brimming with ornate detail and classic charm. Inside, a chic front parlor with original pocket doors, bay windows, and a wood-burning fireplace sets a timeless tone. A versatile 4th bedroom or den sits just beyond. The formal dining room flows effortlessly into a stunning, sun-drenched great room anchored by an updated kitchen with Viking appliances and new countertops. French doors open to a lush backyard for easy indoor-outdoor living, perfect for entertaining. A full bathroom on this level adds function and flexibility. Upstairs, the primary suite includes an office or nursery, custom California Closets, and a remodeled en suite with dual sinks, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. Two vaulted bedrooms share a sunlit balcony overlooking the garden and a second full bath. On the ground level there is a laundry room and two storage rooms that lead to a deep two-car garage. This Liberty Hill location offers easy access to both Castro St and 24th St shopping districts as well as MUNI and tech shuttle stops.
